title: Cygnett 100W Laptop Power Bank 25K + Stand $49 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Bing Lee
body:
Deal: Cygnett 100W Laptop Power Bank 25K + Stand $49 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Bing Lee

[Juandolla] I think , I have addiction to buying Powerbanks . When does someone stop buying them ? What is the limit ??
[safrane] You need different power banks. Like power bank/hand warmer, or power bank/jump starters.
[edrift] How do you use more than one power bank at a time?
[superroach] You need to complete the human centi-power-pad, where one charges another, to another, to another… To charge your phone.
[pw2002au] It's a problem when
- you start buying for family or friends
- you have one (or multiple) stashed in car, work bag, study, bedroom
- you justify that they all have a different purpose (portable, laptop charging, wireless)
- you don't chase up friends to return them
- it's easier to grab a powerbank than actually plug your device into a wall
- you have multiple unopened in a drawer
I have a problem….
[mcgrathkerr] I am so glad that it isn’t just me. Is it an anxiety thing ?
[pw2002au] I prefer always being prepared.. but yes 😎🙃
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] I buy all the power banks and my partner uses them all the time and leaves them empty. My life job is apparently just charging multiple power banks. It's like a split version of the warning signs above. It's definitely easier using a powerbank rather than walking over to a power socket to charge.
[R3XNebular] We must identical twins as wife. Gets frustrated when all power banks are at 0 after using them.
[Bertus] Wish I was the guy having addiction buying SSD nvme and ram sticks when dirt cheap, have plenty of power banks though
[Ezuku] Doesn't look like it. Shame as it would be perfect for overseas travel, but alas I'm transitioning through a domestic flight in china. The ccc mark thing is a huge pain.
[YdoUh8muny] I ordered one of these, been at this price for a little while now. It worked the first time (kind of) - kept my Laptop (Lenovo Legion) alive for an additional 20 minutes from straight out of the box (approx 75% charge I believe).
Second time I went to use it, my laptop wouldn't give the charging icon and it didn't charge at all.
Wouldn't recommend for laptops. Good if you're somewhere with no power and want to keep a couple of smaller devices going.
[Lets Go Brandon] Keep it in your car during summer and it will be.
[zerocents] I have three already and they work great for throwing an extra charge for my laptop in my bag. Pass through charging also works for me (supply > bank > laptop)
[Trishool] I bought one of these, and I've had better.
[prankster] Get the black one , better looking. I got the white one but it’s more like an off shoot grey instead. Tried to exchange at bing lee but no bar
[pongky] I bought two last time this popped up and haven't used them at all yet but I do like the cream / beige look of the 'white' ones. Would look less dirty in terms of dust compared to black. I have to say Bing Lee is a bit slow in posting, I am just so used to free overnight thanks to Amazon
